report.question: Discuss the relationship between Fundamental Rights and Directive Principles of State Policy.

directives.meaning: Look at the issue from more than one side, with reasons, and reach a balanced view.

sentences.text: Fundamental Rights are in Part III and Directive Principles are in Part IV of the Constitution.
Directive Principles can be enforced in courts in the same way as Fundamental Rights.
Directive Principles guide the State in making laws for social and economic justice.
Courts have tried to read both parts together in harmony.
